answer: Creating a sybil costs a fresh stake per identity, so forgery expenses ripple across the attacker's whole fleet, while legitimate agents recover their bond on exit. Each agent must lock a unique timber-bonded identity NFT at a bridge contract, staking real value that slashes on duplicate proof-of-personhood. Cheap throwaway identities become economically irrational. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
